purpose: collect three supplied committed detached SOLVED/1 radial-state objects into one unclosed RETURNED/1 archive containing the complete SPOASM payload

input_contract.assembled: one committed ASSEMBLED/1 archive with exact root and authority inventories, validated same-index fields, and recursively copied TRACK, MICROLIB2 and SYSTEM payloads
input_contract.solved: three distinct exact detached SOLVED/1 roots
input_contract.qsource: three distinct exact detached FROZEN-QFIS/1 roots

same_index_binding.rho: ASSEMBLED root, SYSTEM, SOLVED and QFISS-source RHO are finite positive and binary64 bit-identical
same_index_binding.epoch: ASSEMBLED root, SYSTEM, SOLVED and QFISS-source EPOCH are exactly 1
same_index_binding.leakage: SOLVED/SPOT-LEAK1D and same-index SYSTEM/SPOT-LEAK1D are binary32 bit-identical
same_index_binding.keyflx: SOLVED/KEYFLX, same-index TRACK/KEYFLX and TRACK/KEYFLX$ANIS are integer-identical
same_index_binding.k: source SPOT-KEFF is binary32 bit-identical to real(ASSEMBLED/SPOT-ITER-K,real32)
same_index_binding.qfiss: source SPOT-R64/QFISS is the binary64 authority and source DSOUR is its one-time binary32 mirror
same_index_binding.track_microlib_system_copy: recursive exact copy from the single ASSEMBLED archive

output_contract.legacy_qfiss_shape: SPOT-QFISS outer list length 1 containing 370 binary32 group vectors of length 14
output_contract.authoritative_qfiss_shape: SPOT-R64/QFISS list length 370 containing binary64 group vectors of length 14

source_roles.QFISS: the frozen fission contribution F*phi_n/k_n admitted by the radial equation
source_roles.SOUR: the accepted terminal total radial right-hand side returned by the solver
source_roles.reason: SPOASM fixed-source mode adds final off-group scattering to QFISS and uses SOUR only as the terminal lag witness

provenance_scope.proved: exact label/index binding for listed fields, bitwise binding for admitted numerical fields, and recursive same-index copying of TRACK, MICROLIB2 and SYSTEM
provenance_scope.strong_physical_claim_scope: immediate integrated B2O->B2B->B2R host path or a future sealed tuple receipt

not_claimed: historical QFISS or SYSTEM derivation from detached bits alone
